title: Concept: Employment status in a customer payload
description: An employment status field returned with the account in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Employment status signals income stability, so it is a credit and targeting detail that a payments screen does not need.
applicability: Deployments that render an employment status field returned with the account into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Employment status signals income stability, so it is a credit and targeting detail that a payments screen does not need.
